description: A delay, attack, hold and decay envelope in the manner of the Buchla 281e, the Serge slope generator and the EMS trapezoid, with a pulse at the end of every stage

params.text: Sets the delay between the trigger and the start of the attack, 0 to 10 seconds
Sets the attack time, 0 to 10 seconds
Sets how long the envelope holds at its top before the decay starts, 0 to 10 seconds
Sets the decay time, 0 to 10 seconds
Bends the stages from straight lines towards exponential curves
Scales the envelope, -2 to +2, and turns it upside down at negative settings
Repeats the envelope, starting it again each time it finishes
Stops the envelope at the top of its hold and keeps it there
With it on a new trigger starts the envelope from zero rather than from the level it had reached
With it on a new trigger is taken only once the envelope has finished running

inputs.text: A voltage added to the delay time
A voltage added to the attack time; negative voltage subtracts from it
A voltage added to the hold time
A voltage added to the decay time
A voltage added to the scale
A trigger switches the repeating on
A trigger stops the envelope at the top of its hold and keeps it there
The signal into one of the two VCAs driven by the envelope
A voltage summed into the envelope output, for adding the envelope of another module to this one

outputs.text: The envelope voltage, with any voltage at the chain input summed into it
Sends a trigger whenever the envelope is started, either by a trigger or by the button, for starting another envelope at the same time
The signal out of that VCA, the input scaled by the envelope
A pulse when the delay ends and the attack begins
A pulse when the attack ends and the hold begins
A pulse when the hold ends and the decay begins
A pulse when the decay ends and the envelope comes to rest
